About Contract Compass

What this public research tool does, who maintains it, and how its analysis can be inspected.

Contract Compass is a public browser tool for inspecting Binance USDT perpetual-futures setups. Choose a contract and a holding horizon to read a rule-based decision, its evidence, two conditional scenarios, and an illustrative risk calculation.

Who maintains the app

The project is maintained through the SeyaEli / Contract-Compass repository. The source, changes, and public issue tracker are available there. The app does not claim exchange affiliation, investment-adviser status, or a verified performance record.

How the analysis works

Public completed candles supply trend, momentum, volume, and range information. A fresh live reference price checks whether an entry still meets the rules. Watch is a directional bias, while Wait and No signal are not entries. Read the signal guide for the practical reading order.

What the app does not do

It does not place orders, request exchange credentials, store a portfolio, or promise profits. Its heuristic has no claimed backtested win rate. The calculator uses assumptions and does not calculate liquidation. Futures can produce substantial losses.

Access and funding

The workspace and guides are accessible without a login. Advertising is currently disabled. No ad revenue or sponsorship is represented as active. Support information is on the Contact page.
